description: A key configured for per-value accounting yields a fully-qualified key incorporating the concrete request value, exercised across an alphabetic value, a numeric-looking value, a multibyte unicode value, and an empty value.

configs.name: config.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: m
    detailed_metric: true
    rate_limit:
      unit: hour
      requests_per_unit: 3

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.m_alpha
requests_per_unit=3
unit=HOUR
unlimited=false
shadow_mode=false
